newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Zambia 3-month T-bill discount rate down slightly.
newsitem.headline: Zambia 3-month T-bill discount rate down slightly.

text.p: The central Bank of Zambia sold three-month treasury bills at an average discount of 26.6919 percent at its latest auction, it announced on Monday.
The bank said it sold 20 billion kwacha of the 91-day bills on tenders received at last Thursday's weekly auction. The discount was slightly down from the previous week's 27.5955 percent.
It also said that 10.0 billion kwacha of 28-day bills were sold at an average discount of 24.3962 percent, down from the previous week's 25.3258 percent.
The bank sold 10.0 billion kwacha of six-month (182-day) bills at an average discount of 26.4563 percent, down from the 27.5836 percent discount a week earlier.
